detail.longDescription: # Switzerland Confirms # AI Assisted # Cyberattacks Breached Critical # Infrastructure Operators by Swati Khandelwal, Nov 27, 2026 "Attackers using # AIAgents have broken into computer systems at # Swiss organizations in four of five confirmed attacks, the first such cases in the country, the country's # cybersecurity agency said yesterday. "Three of the attacks targeted critical infrastructure operators, and two of those succeeded, with no major disruptions reported. The victims have not been named, and it is not known who is behind the attacks. "Florian Schütz, who directs Switzerland's National Cyber Security Centre, gave the figures in an interview with public broadcaster SRF. "All five cases were reported in recent days. Small and medium-sized companies were among the organizations hit, and they came forward voluntarily. "The agency's first notice, a security advisory published on Tuesday, said the agents had compromised the victims' IT systems in every case known at that point. Neither the notice nor yesterday's broadcast interview explains why the count changed. " 'These cases represent a shift in the # CyberThreat landscape,' the advisory said."
